engine.title: Engine
engine.description: The engine that runs models directly on this computer.
engine.empty: No model found in this folder.
engine.help: To add a model, use “Add a model” in the chat sidebar, or copy a .gguf file into the models folder above, then click “Refresh”.

delete.title: Delete this model?
delete.message: “{name}” will be removed from this computer. This cannot be undone.

connections.title: Remote shutdown machines
connections.description: The machines Lucania can shut down remotely: this computer or another PC reachable on your network or VPN.
connections.emptyText: Add a machine to be able to shut it down from the sidebar.

delete.title: Delete this connection?
delete.message: “{name}” will be removed. Your conversations are not affected.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Each model has its own memory. Its facts are given to it at the start of every conversation. Everything stays on this computer.
memory.noModelText: Install a model (Settings › Engine) to manage its memory.
memory.enabledHelp: Saved facts are given to the model at the start of every conversation.
memory.autoExtractHelp: The model suggests facts to remember from your conversations.
memory.emptyFacts: No fact saved for this model

shutdown.label: Remote shutdown
shutdown.help: Shows a “Shut down” button in the sidebar.
shutdown.urlInvalid: The listener URL must start with http:// or https://.

shutdown.title: Remote shutdown
shutdown.description: The “Shut down” button in the sidebar sends an HTTP request to a small program running on the remote machine. You need that program's URL and its secret token.
shutdown.urlInvalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
shutdown.tokenCleared: The token will be cleared on save.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose the color theme and the interface language.
appearance.hint: The theme and language are saved on this device.

about.title: About
about.description: Lucania, a local chat interface for language models.
about.dataDirDesktop: This folder is kept across updates and deleted on uninstall.
about.dataDirWeb: Web version: data is stored in the project's data/ folder.

uninstall.title: Uninstall
uninstall.description: Removes Lucania from this computer, along with your conversations and settings.
uninstall.dialogMessage: Your conversations and settings will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

hf.title: Hugging Face
hf.description: Enter an access token to download gated models. To search for and download models, use “Add a model” in the chat sidebar.

token.title: Access token (optional)
token.label: Hugging Face token
token.help: Only needed for gated models. The token is never shown again.
token.link: Create a token on Hugging Face
